messages.subject: Re: Eigen lib optimizations (and Eigen 3.2 compatibility)

On Wednesday, March 20, 2013 12:31:13 PM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
On 3/20/13 11:53 AM, Ben Goodrich wrote:
> Yes, it's working for me too. Do you think the Ref<>
 > thing is going to be a big help?

I haven't quite figured it out yet!   Have you?
For everyone else:

   http://eigen.tuxfamily.org/dox-devel/classEigen_1_1Ref.html

I think the intention is that a Ref<> can be to anything that inherits from MatrixBase, so Matrix<Scalar, Dynamic, Dynamic>, Matrix<Scalar, Dynamic, 1>, Matrix<Scalar, 1, Dynamic>, a Map<> of a Matrix<> a Block<> of a Matrix<> etc. I haven't figured out yet whether expressions like .transpose() would work. But if you combine Ref<> with enable_if / disable_if depending on the Scalar type, then it could simplify a lot of code.

I also think we could probably make more use of .noalias()
than we do, but I'm not 100% sure about that, either.

Yeah, unless you are multiplying a matrix by itself, then we should use .noalias() on the left.

Ben

break apart the really big files and tests and cut down on
interdependencies. But we can clean up things like .noalias()
